name: termux_api_extended
description: Extended Termux:API surfaces including audio, keystore, media, NFC and SAF

capabilities.name: security.keystore
capabilities.description: List, generate, sign, verify or delete Android keystore keys

capabilities.name: media.player
capabilities.description: Play, pause, stop or inspect a media file

capabilities.name: hardware.nfc
capabilities.description: Read or write NFC NDEF data

capabilities.name: storage.saf_dirs
capabilities.description: List directories granted to Termux:API through Storage Access Framework

capabilities.name: storage.saf_managedir
capabilities.description: Grant Termux:API access to a directory through Android's file picker

capabilities.name: storage.saf_ls
capabilities.description: List files in a SAF directory URI

capabilities.name: storage.saf_rm
capabilities.description: Delete a SAF file or directory

capabilities.name: storage.saf_stat
capabilities.description: Get metadata for a SAF file or directory

capabilities.name: ui.notification_channel
capabilities.description: Create or delete an Android notification channel

author: CCOS
